research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Four Growers is researching and developing a produce harvesting system, as described in the title 'Produce harvesting system.' The abstract details a system that includes a robotic limb, a vacuum source, and an end effector for picking produce, along with methods and systems for planning movement paths and controlling the operation of produce packing. These efforts focus on advancing automated harvesting and plant analytics through robotics.
